name: BRAINROT NIGHTMARES
detailed_description:
About This Game

You wake up trapped inside a decaying house. The air is heavy, the lights flicker, and you hear heavy footsteps echoing through the halls. Tung Tung Sahur, a monstrous creature wielding a cursed bat, is roaming and looking for you.

There is no complex puzzle, no multiple endings — only pure survival. Search every room carefully, find the hidden key, and reach the exit door before Tung Tung finds you. Hide under tables or inside a closet to avoid his deadly swings, but don’t stay too long — he’s always listening.

Will you escape, or will you become another victim of the meme-infested nightmare?

Key Features

  • Pure survival horror: Tense, focused gameplay without complicated mechanics.

  • Simple objective: Find the key and escape — that’s it.

  • Terrifying AI: Tung Tung patrols on a fixed route but gets faster over time.

  • Hide and sneak: Only a few spots to hide — use them wisely.

  • Meme horror vibes: Inspired by viral absurdity and Brainrot-style humor.
